fields.description: Program Description Program Overview Elementary Chinese Language Class Week time Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri 8:00-9:50 Intensive Reading Chinese Dialogue Intensive Reading Chinese Intensive Reading Chinese Dialogue 10:00-11:50 Listening Intensive Reading Chinese Listening Oral Chinese Listening 14:00-15:50 Chinese Calligraphy PE Chinese Painting Intensive Chinese Language Class Week time Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri 8:00-9:50 Intensive Reading Chinese Listening Oral Chinese Listening Intensive Reading Chinese 10:00-11:50 Oral Chinese Intensive Reading Chinese Writing Intensive Reading Chinese Oral Chinese 14:00-15:50 Chinese Calligraphy PE Chinese Painting Advanced Chinese Language Class Week time Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri 8:00-9:50 HSK Advanced Advanced Intensive Reading HSK Advanced HSK Advanced Advanced Intensive Reading 10:00-11:50 Advanced Reading HSK Advanced Advanced Intensive Reading Advanced Intensive Reading HSK Advanced 14:00-15:50 Chinese Calligraphy PE Chinese Painting Business Chinese Language Class Week time Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri 8:00-9:50 Comprehensive Reading Listening Business Oral Chinese Listening Comprehensive Reading 10:00-11:50 Business Oral Chinese Comprehensive Reading Writing Comprehensive Reading Business Oral Chinese 14:00-15:50 Chinese Calligraphy PE Chinese Painting PE class: One of Basketball, Football, Chinese Kongfu, Badminton, Yogo, Tennis and Ping-pong Courses Introduction Elementary (A,B) Target Students students at ZERO level Description about teaching (A): Phonetic training, frequently-used vocabulary and sentence patterns, communication skills in their daily life and study. (B): Basic ability to listen and speak, mastering the easy sentence and basic grammer. Intermediate have a basic ability to listen and speak, mastering the easy sentence Frequently-used vocabulary, special patterns, clauses and communication skills in their daily life, study and society. Advanced students having a basic Chinese listening and speaking capability and mastering the general sentence patterns, key compound sentence and with a vocabulary around 2000 up to 2500. The essential Chinese grammer and vocabulary, the special patterns used in oral expression and the general or relatively-complicated communication skills in communication activities related to their study, sociality and work. Business Chinese the course in aimed at students who have already the intermediate level of Chinese and who are now interested in focusing on business-related Chinese. Through the teaching hours spread over 1 semester, students should gain a thorough knowledge and understanding of business related Chinese, andbe able to use it with relative ease in business related activities and situations. Books materials Elementary Boya Chinese (Beijing University Press) Developing Chinese (Beijing Language and Culture University Press) Intensive Developing Chinese (Beijing Language and Culture University Press) Advanced Developing Chinese (Beijing Language and Culture University Press) Advanced Chinese Reading Course (Beijing university Press) HSK Testing (Beijing Language and Culture University Press) and so on Business Chinese Developing Competence in Business Chinese Wining in China Business Chinese Conversation New Skill Business Chinese

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. 1. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 2. Resume Written in Chinese or in English 3. Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 4. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 5. Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
